subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should maintainers require redacted live Telegram or diagnostic proof before merging this owner-session delivery change, or accept the source-level proof and own the delivery risk?
rationale: Source inspection supports the fix shape, but only a real run, logs, recording, or linked artifact can prove that the visible Telegram/session delivery path is not still dropping or misrouting completions.

options.title: Require Live Owner-Session Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing completion delivery to the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while explicitly accepting that real transport/session delivery may still have a hidden drop or misroute.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the completion wake contract unified with the broader detached-subagent liveness work before landing a narrow slice.

recommendation.title: Require Live Owner-Session Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing completion delivery to the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest adjacent history across heartbeat scheduling and subagent completion delivery, which is the boundary behind the proof decision.
